rule: Every authored story, online, and side mission has an opening cutscene and a post-mission cutscene. Selected missions also have one or more in-mission cutscenes triggered by objective beats.

sequence_types.opening: Plays before the first playable objective and establishes context, characters, location and immediate stakes.
sequence_types.in_mission: Optional gameplay-to-Sequencer transitions triggered by authored objective beats; gameplay resumes at a deterministic marker.
sequence_types.post_mission: Plays after mission success/failure resolution as appropriate and establishes consequences, rewards and the next story/world state.

skip_rules.first_play: Player may skip only after the scene has been viewed for 3 seconds.
skip_rules.online: All party members receive a synchronized scene start/end signal; late joiners receive a state snapshot rather than restarting the scene.
skip_rules.failure: Failure scenes may be skippable and return to the mission retry state.

production.implementation: Level Sequence + Sequencer + Gameplay Tags + server-authoritative mission state for online
production.assets: Original characters, vehicles, environments and animation
